test_cases.name: System Boot and Hardware Initialization
test_cases.description: Verify target microcontroller boots cleanly, initializes peripherals, and settles into initial state.
preconditions: Target hardware powered on or reset asserted
actions: Apply nominal operating voltage to board
Release hardware reset line
Observe boot diagnostics and startup log
test_cases.expected_behavior: Firmware transitions to initial state 'SYSTEM_INIT' with default peripheral outputs asserted and boot announcement logged.
failure_conditions: Microcontroller enters infinite loop or watchdog crash
Initial outputs do not match default safe state
Boot announcement missing from serial monitor

test_cases.name: Nominal Normal Operation: temperature at 25.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Validate firmware steady-state behavior under nominal temperature (25.0 Celsius).
preconditions: System booted successfully in normal operating state
actions: Inject steady nominal temperature reading of 25.0 Celsius
Allow sensor sampling cycle to execute
Verify actuator states and output telemetry
test_cases.expected_behavior: Firmware remains in normal operating state with temperature within nominal limits. Outputs remain in inactive/cooling standby.
failure_conditions: System triggers false positive alarm or unexpected actuation
Firmware fails to sample or parse sensor input

test_cases.name: Threshold Boundary Below: temperature at 29.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify system behavior immediately below decision threshold (30.0 Celsius).
preconditions: System operational in normal monitoring state
actions: Inject temperature input of 29.0 Celsius (1 Celsius below 30.0 Celsius threshold)
Execute control loop evaluation
test_cases.expected_behavior: Fan remains OFF; state is SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING
failure_conditions: Actuator prematurely triggered below threshold at 29.0 Celsius

test_cases.name: Threshold Boundary Exact: temperature at 30.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify strict boundary condition handling exactly at threshold (30.0 Celsius).
preconditions: System operational in normal monitoring state
actions: Inject temperature input exactly at threshold (30.0 Celsius)
Execute control loop evaluation
test_cases.expected_behavior: Boundary at 30.0 C: <= 30.0 C is OFF, strictly > 30.0 C turns fan ON. Values < -20.0 C or > 120.0 C trigger SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT
failure_conditions: Premature boundary trip or oscillation at exactly 30.0 Celsius

test_cases.name: Threshold Boundary Above: temperature at 31.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify activation immediately above decision threshold (30.0 Celsius).
preconditions: System operational in normal monitoring state
actions: Inject temperature input of 31.0 Celsius (1 Celsius above 30.0 Celsius threshold)
Execute control loop evaluation
test_cases.expected_behavior: Fan turns ON; state is SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE
failure_conditions: Actuator failed to engage when threshold exceeded at 31.0 Celsius

test_cases.name: Sensor Boundary Min Limit: temperature at -20.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify valid operation at lowest documented sensor boundary (-20.0 Celsius).
actions: Inject sensor reading at minimum operational limit (-20.0 Celsius)
Execute sensor validation routines
test_cases.expected_behavior: Valid sensor reading at boundary -20.0 Celsius; system processes reading without error.
failure_conditions: False sensor fault reported at valid minimum reading -20.0 Celsius

test_cases.name: Sensor Boundary Below Min Limit: temperature at -21.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify detection and handling of reading violating minimum sensor boundary (-21.0 Celsius).
actions: Inject sensor reading violating lower boundary (-21.0 Celsius < -20.0 Celsius)
Execute boundary checking routine
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reading below -20.0 Celsius is recognized as out-of-range; triggers fault mitigation.
failure_conditions: System accepted out-of-range reading below -20.0 Celsius as valid

test_cases.name: Sensor Boundary Max Limit: temperature at 120.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify operation at highest documented sensor boundary (120.0 Celsius).
actions: Inject sensor reading at maximum operational limit (120.0 Celsius)
Execute sensor processing routine
test_cases.expected_behavior: Valid sensor reading at maximum limit 120.0 Celsius; processed without fault.
failure_conditions: False sensor fault reported at valid maximum reading 120.0 Celsius

test_cases.name: Sensor Boundary Above Max Limit: temperature at 121.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Verify detection and handling of reading violating maximum sensor boundary (121.0 Celsius).
actions: Inject sensor reading violating upper boundary (121.0 Celsius > 120.0 Celsius)
Execute boundary checking routine
test_cases.expected_behavior: Reading above 120.0 Celsius is recognized as out-of-range; triggers fault mitigation.
failure_conditions: System accepted out-of-range reading above 120.0 Celsius as valid

test_cases.name: Abnormal Extreme Negative Input: temperature at -999.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Stress-test input sanitizer against severe negative out-of-range temperature reading.
actions: Inject extreme negative temperature of -999.0 Celsius
Verify firmware error trap and sanitization
test_cases.expected_behavior: System safely rejects extreme negative input and asserts fail-safe state.
failure_conditions: System crashes, overflows, or enters undefined state on extreme negative input

test_cases.name: Abnormal Extreme Positive Input: temperature at +999.0 Celsius
test_cases.description: Stress-test input sanitizer against severe positive out-of-range temperature reading.
actions: Inject extreme positive temperature of 999.0 Celsius
Verify firmware error trap and sanitization
test_cases.expected_behavior: System safely rejects extreme positive input and asserts fail-safe state.
failure_conditions: System crashes, overflows, or enters undefined state on extreme positive input

test_cases.name: Sensor Disconnection and Hardware Fault Mitigation
test_cases.description: Simulate physical sensor disconnection / open circuit and verify fail-safe shutdown.
preconditions: System active with cooling or normal monitoring engaged
actions: Disconnect physical temperature sensor signal wire (open circuit: -99.0 C reading)
Invoke sensor processing routine
Verify immediate transition to safe fault state
test_cases.expected_behavior: System detects sensor fault, transitions to 'SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT', deactivates actuators to prevent unmonitored operation, and emits serial alert.
failure_conditions: Actuator remains active during sensor disconnection
System fails to transition to 'SYSTEM_SENSOR_FAULT'
Error alert not logged over serial

test_cases.name: State Transition: SYSTEM_INIT -> SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING
test_cases.description: Validate state transition from 'SYSTEM_INIT' to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING' upon 'First valid temperature reading <= 30.0 C'.
actions: Configure system to state 'SYSTEM_INIT'
Apply transition trigger condition: First valid temperature reading <= 30.0 C
Inspect state variable and hardware pin outputs
test_cases.expected_behavior: System successfully transitions from 'SYSTEM_INIT' to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING'. Action executed: set_fan(false).
failure_conditions: System failed to transition to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING'
System transitioned to incorrect state or locked up
Output pins do not match destination state specifications

test_cases.name: State Transition: SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING -> SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE
test_cases.description: Validate state transition from 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING' to 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE' upon 'Temperature exceeds threshold'.
actions: Configure system to state 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING'
Apply transition trigger condition: Temperature exceeds threshold
Inspect state variable and hardware pin outputs
test_cases.expected_behavior: System successfully transitions from 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING' to 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE'. Action executed: set_fan(true).
failure_conditions: System failed to transition to 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE'
System transitioned to incorrect state or locked up
Output pins do not match destination state specifications

test_cases.name: State Transition: SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE -> SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING
test_cases.description: Validate state transition from 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE' to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING' upon 'Temperature cools down to threshold or below'.

inputs.trigger: Temperature cools down to threshold or below

actions: Configure system to state 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE'
Apply transition trigger condition: Temperature cools down to threshold or below
Inspect state variable and hardware pin outputs
test_cases.expected_behavior: System successfully transitions from 'SYSTEM_FAN_ACTIVE' to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING'. Action executed: set_fan(false).
failure_conditions: System failed to transition to 'SYSTEM_NORMAL_COOLING'
System transitioned to incorrect state or locked up
Output pins do not match destination state specifications

metadata.trigger: Temperature cools down to threshold or below

test_cases.name: Unexpected Input: High-Frequency Jitter Around Threshold (30.0 Celsius)
test_cases.description: Inject rapid alternating readings (29.8 Celsius and 30.2 Celsius) to test debouncing/hysteresis.
actions: Inject fluctuating input rapidly crossing 30.0 Celsius threshold at 50Hz
Monitor output relay line for chatter or race conditions
test_cases.expected_behavior: System remains stable without relay chatter or undefined oscillation.
failure_conditions: Relay chatters uncontrollably or controller enters race condition

test_cases.name: Combination: Cold Boot with Pre-Existing Elevated temperature (35.0 Celsius)
test_cases.description: Evaluate initial boot behavior when ambient temperature is already exceeding 30.0 Celsius. Verifies system does not stay stuck in idle if started in hot environment.
actions: Preset temperature stimulus to 35.0 Celsius
Apply power / release reset
Observe state transition from boot to active cooling
test_cases.expected_behavior: System boots, immediately detects temperature > 30.0, and transitions directly to active cooling.
failure_conditions: System remains in idle state despite elevated startup temperature

test_cases.name: Combination: Sudden Sensor Disconnection During Active Actuator Run
test_cases.description: Verify fail-safe shutdown occurs immediately when sensor disconnects while actuator is actively engaged.
preconditions: System running in active state with actuator energized (e.g. at 35.0 C)
actions: Establish active cooling state (temperature = 35.0 C, fan = ON)
Suddenly disconnect sensor wire (-99.0 C reading)
Verify fan is de-energized within one execution cycle
test_cases.expected_behavior: Actuator is immediately de-energized and system transitions to fault state without lingering.
failure_conditions: Actuator remains energized after sensor fault injection
